My Bird Spot — Texas game birds, week by week, all year.
Season dates, bag limits and zone lines: TPWD Outdoor Annual 2026–27 · Live: National Weather Service · Imagery & topo: USGS The National Map · Turkey score: NWTF formula. Zones are found from your zip code and are a best guess near a zone line — check TPWD’s zone maps. Always check your county’s rules in the TPWD Outdoor Annual before you hunt.
Change log
  • Rev 1.3 (Oct 19, 2026) — The Etsy order number no longer shows on screen.
  • Rev 1.2 (Oct 18, 2026) — Real photos: mourning doves on the dove-week covers, plus a Photo of the Week in the feature story (doves, strutting gobblers, a flushing rooster pheasant, a bobwhite covey flush).
  • Rev 1.1 (Oct 18, 2026) — Live covers: wings beat, birds glide, flocks drift across the sky, the gobbler struts and the water shimmers. Phones set to Reduce Motion keep the still picture.
  • Rev 1 (Oct 18, 2026) — First edition: magazine cover, 48-week guide for 12 Texas game birds (dove, teal, ducks, geese, sandhill crane, quail, pheasant, turkey, chachalaca, woodcock, snipe, rails), 2026–27 season clock for your zones, What’s Flying report, zone lines on the map, spot pins with wind picker, live wind and front alerts, legal shooting light for migratory and upland birds, Brag Board with turkey score and band reporting, share cards, 4-digit unlock code.

Turkey score — NWTF formula (optional)
